hints.title: Half Palindrome Symmetry
hints.text: Because the entire string must remain a palindrome, any modification to the first half completely dictates the mirrored second half.

hints.title: Next Permutation on Half
hints.text: Execute standard next permutation on the first half of the string.

hints.title: Reconstruct and Mirror
hints.text: If a greater permutation of the first half exists, mirror it around the optional odd center element.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def nextPalindromicPermutation(self, s: str) -> str:
        # s is a palindrome string
        # Find next permutation of first half, then reflect
        n = len(s)
        half = list(s[:n // 2])
        # Next permutation on half
        i = len(half) - 2
        while i >= 0 and half[i] >= half[i + 1]:
            i -= 1
        if i < 0:
            return "" # no greater permutation exists
        j = len(half) - 1
        while half[j] <= half[i]:
            j -= 1
        half[i], half[j] = half[j], half[i]
        half[i + 1:] = reversed(half[i + 1:])
        
        mid = s[n // 2] if n % 2 == 1 else ""
        return "".join(half) + mid + "".join(reversed(half))
```

variables: N: length of palindrome string s
complexity.notes: Linear time next permutation applied on string prefix.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations of the entire string takes exponential time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reduce palindromic permutations to prefix permutation with mirror reflection.
